meta.name: biopython
meta.description: Provides Biopython workflows for sequence manipulation, file parsing (FASTA/GenBank/PDB), phylogenetics, and programmatic NCBI/PubMed access (Bio.Entrez). Supports batch processing, custom molecular-biology pipelines, BLAST automation, structure analysis, and motif analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 解析基因序列与结构文件,自动完成比对、检索与进化分析流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果日常要和 FASTA/GenBank 等生物序列数据打交道
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you routinely work with FASTA/GenBank biological sequence data

howto.what: Claude 会用 Biopython 处理生物序列数据：读写与转换 FASTA、GenBank、PDB 等格式，做序列比对、跑并解析 BLAST、访问 NCBI 数据库、构建进化树、分析蛋白质结构。
howto.when: 当你需要处理生物序列、读写 FASTA/GenBank 等文件格式，或访问 NCBI 数据库等任务时接管。

say.text: 把 sequences.fasta 里每条序列的长度和 GC 含量算出来
say.note: Claude 会读参考文档后用 SeqIO 处理该文件

say.text: 把我给的序列跑一次 blastn，列出前 5 个命中及 E 值

howto.what_en: Claude uses Biopython for biological sequences: reading and converting FASTA, GenBank, PDB files, aligning sequences, running and parsing BLAST, querying NCBI, building trees, analyzing protein structures.
howto.when_en: Use it when you need to work with DNA/RNA/protein sequences, read or write formats like FASTA or GenBank, or access NCBI databases and run BLAST.

say_en.text: Count the length and GC content of every sequence in sequences.fasta
say_en.note: Claude reads the reference docs and runs SeqIO on that file

say_en.text: Search PubMed via Entrez for biopython papers and return the first 10
say_en.note: Uses Bio.Entrez.esearch with your NCBI email set

say_en.text: Run blastn on my sequence and list the top 5 hits with their E-values
say_en.note: Uses Bio.Blast NCBIWWW and parses the XML output
